annotations.title: Run SQL over all of Sui

description: Run one SQL SELECT over every Sui transaction, event, object version and balance change since genesis. Needs an API key. Returns up to 100 rows; page with execution_id and offset. If it is still running, call again with execution_id. Tables and columns: https://api.tide.ad/v1/sql/schema. Example: { query: "SELECT sequence_number, total_transaction_blocks FROM sui.checkpoints ORDER BY sequence_number DESC LIMIT 5" }. Needs an API key.

execution_id.description: The execution_id of an earlier run, to get its rows or more of them.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for the next page.
